observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show large stacks of blue plastic drums piled outdoors on bare dirt ground.
Drums appear to be standard cylindrical industrial barrels, likely ~200L size based on proportions.
Surfaces show rust-colored staining, scuff marks, and weathering consistent with prior outdoor/industrial use.
Some drums have small warning/hazard labels affixed near the bung holes, but text is too small/blurred to read in either photo.
Bung caps are visible on some drums; condition of seals/threads cannot be assessed from distance.
No visible cracks or holes, but photos are taken from a few meters away, not close-up.
Watermark 'EMMALINK CONCEPT NIG' overlaid on both images, seller's business branding, not a product brand.

claims.claim: Plastic drum for storage of any kind of liquid
claims.evidence: No close-up shot of seals, bung threads, or leak test; hazard labels on drums (photo 0, photo 1) are unread, so prior contents and food-safety/chemical-safety suitability cannot be confirmed.

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the hazard label/sticker text near the bung hole showing prior contents.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown-origin industrial drum, not food-grade

risks.risk: Structural cracks, dents, or stress fractures not visible at stack distance.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each drum's body and base, plus a water-fill or pressure test clip.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/unverified condition, worst case possible minor damage

risks.risk: Bung cap/seal may not be airtight or leak-proof.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the bung cap and threads, ideally with cap removed and reseated.

risks.risk: Actual capacity/size not confirmed (assumed ~200L from shape).
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure or a spec sticker showing liter capacity.
risks.if_unproven: priced at smallest plausible standard size for this drum shape

risks.risk: Unclear whether price covers a single drum or the whole stack/bulk lot shown.
risks.proof: Seller statement or photo clarifying unit count being sold.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the hazard/warning label text on one drum
Close-up photo of the bung cap and threads
Photo of drum with a measuring tape for height/diameter
Confirmation of whether listing price is per drum or for multiple drums
A photo showing the drum filled with water to check for leaks
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used plastic storage drum by type; though its prior contents, leak-tightness, and exact capacity are unverified, these can be priced at worst-case assumptions without needing further proof to assign a baseline value.
